text: I got it to filter my kombucha. The elastic at top fits over jar top great eliminating messes I was having before.
Quality, safe bags.

I finally used one.  I put 6 ounces of ground coffee in the filter and steeped for 12 hours in 40 ounces of water.  This process made 26 ounces of coffee concentrate.  I've used The Toddy for years, but now I can soak the grounds in glass instead of plastic.  It is messier dealing with the used grounds and cloth, but the coffee tastes the same.
Exactly what I was looking for! I love how easy the tie feature is! I would definitely recommend this product!

These are the perfect cold brew bags I have been looking for.
Thank you
exactly what i was hoping for - they work perfectly!

Love these! I had a question on cleaning instructions and the Seller sent me a message right away with
instructions. Thank you!
Made my first cold brew the other day. 2 cups of course ground with 64 oz. water. De-lish. Emptied the bag, then turned it inside out to rinse it out. Easy peasy.
Great for my kombucha making!
Just bought another one to use in my coffee shop. Love fresh whip to make frappes. Customer comment on the taste all the time

I make a herbal infusion for myself every night before bed. I brew 1oz dried herb in a quart jar of boiling water and let it steep all night. In the morning I usually have to run it through a cheesecloth or a tea towel to squeeze out the infusion and it is messy. I've tried the drawstring brew bags without much success. I'm so glad I found these, they're just perfect in every way. I love the elastic, at first it seems like it wouldn't hold the bag closed completely, but it does, no little bits have escaped into my drink.

I've run them through the wash with my towels several times so far, there is minimal staining and no sign of the seams going bad or the hem coming loose. I feel pretty confident these are going to last me awhile.

I just bought these, and they're great! No mess, no straining grounds through my tiny strainer anymore. I love that they have an elastic that keeps the bags closed rather than a drawstring. No trapped grounds! Easy peasy!

These are perfect for brewing loose tea, making cold brew coffee and straining second ferment kombucha tea. Bags are super easy to close and open and do not accidently open. Definitely recommend these bags.
These bags make cold brewing a breeze. They're easy to wash and make the process super easy to set up and clean up as well. I highly recommend them.
Removes all the mystery and the fanfare from the cold brew. With these bags, nothing to it, and for pennies, anytime! I love'em!

I rarely write 5 star reviews because I think people. Don't trust them, BUT I love these things. Fill with 2 cups ground coffee (I've used Bustello Espresso and Dunkin'). Both worked great with not a single ground at the bottom. I use a gallon glass jar, put in the bag full of coffee, then fill it about 3/4 to the top and let it sit on the counter for 18-36 hours. Then I decant it into smaller containers and refrigerate. You can always dilute cold brew if it's too strong. Days of coffee pleasure, always ready. I squeeze water from the the full bag once it's brewed to a color I like. It's easy to then open bag and dump grounds into trash can. Then I rinse the bag (inside and out) and use a bit of dish soap to hand wash. Takes seconds and dries in a few hours. Great design with attached elastic.

I had been making cold brew coffee this summer with unbleached paper filters and wooden clothespins to hold the coffee inside. This cloth bag is a huge improvement and there is no paper taste to the cold brew concentrate. Just very strong, not bitter, delicious coffee flavor. On a cooler morning, I add hot water. On a hot one, I pour the concentrate over ice and add more cold water. The elastic band only needs to go around the bag's top once, so it's easy and quick. The e-booklet link provided is very well done. Highly recommended.

These would be great for only making small batches or using a very wide mouth container if making a large quantity, as they do hold 2 cups of course grounds for a gallon of final brew. Shape is bad for using in my 1/2 gallon jar. Impossible to drip when brew is done without dumping some of the coffee out first. Instead of being able to drip, I did two rounds of this...empty brew into my tap jar, open the bag and pour water thru , squeeze bag inside of jar, dump again without loosing any grounds into my jar. Then I dumped the grounds to remove the bag from my brew jar, you get the picture. It was a major pain in the behind for something that is usually fast & simple when I use my 1/2 gal Coffee Sock tapered bag.

As far as the bag goes, I liked the elastic band for closing and the bag quality seems very good. I will use only in a pinch for small batches or when traveling, as they would be great for this to make a nice big cup over night in your hotel.
My brew tasted fine and luckily I ended up with no grounds in the jar and the bag did it's job here initially.

I prefer glass for brewing and only have a 1/2 gal mason jar I use for this. If for some reason I use this bag again for my gal of final brew I will have to brew it in my gallon tap jar if I want to be able to drip it first & for easy removal.
I love cold brewing for it's ease and having coffee ready for my whole work week & whenever I want some.
This bag doesn't quite cut it for my us

I'm new to cold brewing at home and i tried it first without this filter and I tried it again with the filter.  My observations: both were really great, with the filter, there's less sediment and it makes cleanup afterwards much easier.
Exactly what we were looking for!
This works perfectly! So easy to use, just throw in ground coffee, close and throw in a container of water. Let sit for 12-24 hours at room temp. Clean up is a breeze, just empty and rinse.

I absolutely love, love, love these coffee filter bags. It's all about the loop. Okay, not ALL about the loop ... but the loop is what sets these bags apart and makes this particular "cold brew coffee sock" the one to buy.

I have been making cold brew coffee for years. I started with a mason jar of water and coffee, which I then filtered through cheese cloth. Messy and inconvenient. I later switched to the Toddy cold brew system, which is much neater but is bulky and (to be honest) uses a sponge filter that kind of grosses me out with the perceived icky factor even though I boiled it after every use and then air dried it. These bags bring me back to my cold brew mason jar roots, but without the mess and inconvenience.

Why are these bags so great? 1) They filter out almost 100% of the silt. I have used other metal filters that still leave silty dregs in the bottom of your container. 2) They are super convenient. Just fill with coffee, run water through the bag, loop the loop, and lid the container. 3) The loop -- My neighbor has a bag with a drawstring. The drawstring is a pain in the patootie. That's why I held off so long on buying my own bag. Then I found these. Love the loop. 4) The entire system is easy and portable. This is great for traveling AND takes up much less room than my Toddy. I've totally switched to the bags even when I am at home. 5) The bags are super easy to clean. I have made two batches of cold brew using the filter and I am so happy with the result. While making cold brew is easy no matter which way you make it, these bags make it even easier.
Before these bags, I would soak course ground coffee in a pitcher for 24 hours. I would then strain the coffee grounds using a strainer and cheesecloth. My main complain was the excess grounds that would end up in my cold brew. It was also a timely process to strain the grounds and required extra dishes to wash.
These filters do a great job of keeping the grounds contained. I simply remove the bag, compost the grounds and wash the bag. No need to strain.
I am so glad I made this purchase!

These bags are awesome, and make amazing cold brew coffee! The little elastic band is perfect for cinching the bag closed and keeping the grinds in. I like to roll up the bag then double it over before cinching, then releasing is as easy as pulling on the loop. I have used course and fine grinds with success, without any sediment permeating the bags and ending up in the brew. Emptying & cleaning the bags is as easy as flipping them inside out and rinsing, maybe with a drop of dish soap, and then letting air dry. I love the fact that they are all natural, organic, unbleached cotton, and are inert in terms of changing the flavor of your brew. I might be a bit addicted to cold brew iced coffee now...

Absolutely love these filters. I have brewing away for a few weeks now. No leaking, easy to clean, and are a fantastic product.
Very satisfied with my purchase. The company also emailed me a recipe book for different brews, flavors, etc. Great service!
Love it! Very easy to use.
worked well for my cold brew coffee. saw no escaped grounds, looks like it will last for awhile, and it's relatively easy to clean.  would recommend to a friend.
Works great for cold brew.  I use a big jar and brew it for 18 hours—no coffee grounds residue settles on the bottom!

These work wonderfully. I have used them for over a month brewing cold brew coffee. They make it much easier to drink instead of having to filter the brew after it is completed. No grinds in my drink, ever! Get some. They are durable and fit perfectly inside my gallon glass jars from pickles or tightly around the opening of the 80 ounce glass containers.
Easy to clean, good permeability without letting any coffee grounds loose.

These work great for cold brew coffee. It will hold just under a pound of coffee without pushing the limit of the elastic green tie attached to the bag. No seeping of coffee grounds into the coffee and easy clean up

So much easier than my old method...easy cleaning...great tasting cold brew with very little (if any) sediment.  Can easily see this as a great options for other beverages, but cold brew is my standby...

I love these organic cotton cold brew bags!  This filters the coffee so cleanly, and is easy to use.  I grind my coffee beans course and measure out 1 cup of grounds in the bag.  I cold brew in a 1/2 gallon wide mouth mason jar.  The bag folds nicely around the neck of the jar, I don't even use the green band...the lid is a bit tight unless I avoid placing it where the elastic is, but it seems simpler that way.  Cleaning the bag is super easy too, the seams are finished in such a way that the do not trap any grounds.  I love that two bags came with my order - we go through alot of coffee, so I usually have two jars going at any point in time.

easy to use, brews overnight
the coffee tastes good, very mellow
the bag is easy to clean, usually dump the ground in the yard, then rinse out the bag
So great!  Works very well.
Easy to use, easy to clean. Makes great cold brew coffee.
These filters work great for cold brew coffee. Each bag is easy to fill, use, and clean.
They were a gift so I don't know, I think they were smaller than expected.
Works great. I use the bags all the time.

These brew bags are fantastic. I am a Starbucks barista and I know our process of making our large batches of Cold Brew Iced Coffee. I've been looking for a way to recreate this recipe and I was missing the large filter bags (Starbucks uses a giant coffee filter the size of a pillow case).

I have found that these bags are re-usable and are perfect for an environmentally friendly coffee brewing process! They are large enough to hold about 2-3 cups of ground coffee, which is enough for me to make a strong batch of cold brew to last me all week. Notice, this comes with TWO bags, so you could easily put 2-3 coffee cups of coffee in each bag and make a bigger batch to last two people all week. They do send an e-book with coffee brewing recipes. I suggest to experiment and find a way that works best for you. They provide a good guideline to follow though. Some things to consider are the type of bean you are getting, how it is roasted, if it's bought whole bean and ground as needed or pre-ground, and the strength of the coffee you like. I enjoy very strong coffee where one cup is enough for the day. So I brew mine on the stronger side (meaning more coffee less water and more time soaking). However, if you want it weaker, then do less coffee, more water, and for less time.

Also, I bought some Torani caramel syrup for added flavor and it's delicious. Sure, you can buy the Starbucks caramel syrup but it's more expensive and you have to pay shipping (if bought dire
Makes great cindy brew coffee!!!
Easy to use and dry

I am a big fan of these bags! I was using paper towels and a colander to strain my coffee which worked, but was messy and time consuming. The bags seriously leave maybe 0.5% silt in the container! Amazing. The loop works really well and I'm so glad i didn't get a draw string bag cuz i can see how they'd be difficult to work with. I use the fine grind coffee from Kirkland cuz I've tried all types and grinds and can't really tell a difference. The bags can hold 3-4 cups of grinds so then i can soak it in my big tupperware overnight and then transfer to pourable pitcher in the morning to keep in fridge.
Great product, I'm telling all my friends!

(Note: I am a professional barista.)

I've now brewed several batches with these bags and so far they have been excellent and exactly as advertised. I am a major coffee nerd and rotate roasts weekly. I can tell you that these bags do not in any way interfere with bringing out the full range and subtlety of each roast.

The green elastic is indeed every bit as convenient as promised. The visual instructions are HILARIOUSLY bad (seriously, have a good laugh about it), but it's entirely intuitive. Just use it exactly like a hairband. Twice around does the trick.

Some people complain that coffee grounds "get stuck in the corners" on square bags like this, but I don't understand what the issue is. Just turn the bag inside out when you rinse it.

As with anything that you stain with coffee, you should expect these to become an eyesore once you start using them, but I promise that no matter how crinkly or ugly they are, they keep making great coffee.

If I ever run into any issues, I'll update this review. But if it's still at 5 stars, assume it's still smooth coffee sailing for me!

I've been using small silk bags to make the tea for my big batches of Kombucha. They invariably break their strings after just a few batches. These bags are bigger and thicker and for now, the twist works. I haven't yet used this for making cold brew. But it works for my current use!
Much smaller than I thought they would be but they work as advertised.
This is how to make smooth cold brewed coffee at home. I enjoy the fancy store sometimes but this is just as good butLove for a fraction of the price.

I make a batch of cold brew every other day or so.  This has been my best cold brew investment by far.  Previously, it would take me hours of straining to get all the sludge out of my batch and that was after using a coffee sock or a filter specifically for making cold brew.  These coffee bags leave next to nothing in my container and the cold brew tastes amazing!  I have already told some family and friends that have tasted my cold brew and I have a feeling these will be selling like hotcakes!

I'm a real coffee snob. I've been roasting my own beans for over 10 years, usually from Ethiopia, Costa Rica, or Sumatra, and have tried just about every method of brewing there is. For the past few years, it has been a Chemex, and I thought that was the best. But I was wrong.

Using this bag for cold brew is amazing! I used the recipe included in the PDF they sent me: 113 grams of coarsely ground coffee and 1 liter of water. I bought a sealed pitcher that's recommended for this by Amazon:

https://www.amazon.com/Hermetic-Glass-Pitcher-Homemade-Bottles/dp/B0131EKHO0

and dilute with hot water whenever I want a cup (it's easy to adjust the strength to suit). The resulting cup is amazing. Highly recommended!
These bags are perfect for my needs and the quality is exactly as I hoped. This was my second purchase of these and the new loop size is much more to my liking. Highly recommended.

I've been using one of these bags to make cold brew coffee. It filters out about 99% of the sediment. I use the other one for racking my wine/mead must. It doesn't filter as well as the one for the coffee, but it works better than anything else I've tried, so I'm happy.

This filter bag does everything I could expect of it to make the process of cold brew coffee extremely easy. Negligible small sediment in the bottom of the pitcher. No holes and the elastic works well.

Perfect for making almond milk!  I love fresh, homemade almond milk but struggled to make it using cheese cloth (super messy & time consuming).  No more!  These bags make it so easy, fast and clean.  The cloth easily separates the milk from the gritty almond residue and leaves a super creamy & smooth milk.  Making almond milk now takes a few minutes with very little clean-up. Also, this size is perfect for making a 2 cup serving of almond milk (1 cup almonds & 2 cups water).  So happy to have discovered these!  Highly recommend!
Excellent product!  We use some classic old style Mason jars and steep the coffee for 1-2 days. Works perfectly and really keeps the grounds out of the liquid.

I just started making cold brew and was using cheesecloth/strainer method...until I found these wonderful bags! The cheesecloth was unbelievably messy and I always wound up with grounds and silt in my coffee no matter how careful I was. Even though I have arthritis, the elastic band is easy to use whether the bag is dry or wet. When squeezing the bag, the elastic band holds so well no grounds come out of the top and there is virtually no silt in my final coffee. The e-book was a great help too since I'm a newbie at this. Also, a shout out to this company--I contacted them with a question and they got back to me very quickly. Today I am attempting to make coconut milk using the other bag which I'm certain will work just as well. I'm looking forward to doing business with this company again in the future.
Love the bags! I've tried other options out there such as a metal/mesh strainers and these are way better!
little messy for cleaning out but over all like it
I haven't actually made cold brew coffee yet, although that's on the bucket list. Nut milk is our bag - and this is the perfect one for it! Thanks Organic Family Products!
These bags are really good.  Easy to use and the coffee tastes great!

Pretty fine mesh for cold brew coffee, keeping the finer grounds contained.  Obviously some escape and while I still paper filter the coffee before drinking, I can see some people not.  It is a little pricey for two cotton bags though.  Maybe next time I'll sew my own...or not.

Makes cold brew so easy. Elastic design is much superior to string ties.

Only issue I've had is a few threads coming loose at the bottom of the bag. I assume it'll eventually come loose, but it's still in good shape after 10+ batches. Haven't even used the second bag yet.
We are very happy with the bags. The cold brew is very good and easy to make!
I have used these to make cold brew coffee and cold brew tea. So far the product works amazingly well!
Good sock for my cold brew. Thanks
These things work great and have been pleasantly easy to use and clean. I can make cold brew with this, a pitcher, and absolutely minimal effort - love it!

These bags work really well for smaller amounts. I have since started using them a secondary filter. I use a nylon mesh bag initially and then pour the cold brew into the bag whilst in a pitcher. It filters all the small particles very well. I will buy more when these wear out.
I just think they are pricey for what they are. I saw them cheaper at the store

Works good. I'm not a fancy coffee drinker...but I really like cold brew. I've only done 4...I've got to get the grind right. Don't press the bag around when you are brewing..the fines get out. I didn't touch it last brew...and there was nothing in the bottom of my brew jar. The rubber band is a great idea.

I use these bags to make my cold brew coffee. They are easy to use, easy to seal, and easy to clean up. I also use them for my loose tea leaves. These bags make it very easy to make enough cold brew coffee or tea to fill a large container.
Works very well

Easy to use, easy to clean AND it's organic!
What's there not to like?
Delivery was oddly (but grateful!) fast!
Love it, love it, love it!
Recommended to all my friends and family!
Cold Brew coffee bags are simple and easy to use, works well for cold brewing coffee and holds a large amount of coffee for brewing several cups

The replacement "clear Choice" water filter installed just fine, and ice maker works great.....end...!  The filtered water does not come on and it has been at least a month and still no water..!!  Not the filters fault but it seems that all these double door GE refrigerators have this problem. Googled the problem and 90% said that the water line has frozen..!  All gave their version of how to clear the water line. I have not gotten to the fix as yet.
Works perfect and price was amazing

Perfect fit for our fridge.our last had been out for 2 years and sure is nice to have it taste right. We have been hesitant to purchase one since filters can be very expensive but since I was able to get this one for free it was the best time to give it a chance.
Returned it due to particles in the water when held up to a light. Ran water through it for 10 minutes with no changes.  Put tap water in a glass up to a light and the tap water had no particles.
Works perfectly with my GE GNS23G fridge.  No leaks, clean water, 1/3 price of OEM.

I can't speak to how the water tastes with a GE Filter vs Clear Choice since I bought my refrigerator used from the Disabled Veterans Thrift store.  However, it arrived within a few days & it fits GE GSH25KGREWW, side by side, without any leaks or other issues.
Great product!

Read some reviews that said their filter dripped/leaked, so far mine hasn't. It installed easily, came quickly, doesn't leak, priced much better than brand name (less than 1/2) and ice tastes like ice. Thanks.

RM
Pop in in seconds, works like a charm, and for 1/3 the cost of a GE. Thanks!
Filter fit perfectly and flow is good.  There is no certificate or marking on the box with NSF certifications
It is identical to the name brand and much less expensive! Thank you!
We forgot to run a bit of water thru first, but after that the water is better than the tap water for sure. And this is a lower cost alternative to the GE branded ones.

I changed my old filter and installed this one with no issues at all. It works perfectly and my water tastes great. I don't even know how long it had been since the filter was changed, so the old one was pretty bad. Now, the water comes out faster and has no chlorine smell or taste at all!
Bought this for the filter at work. Everyone seems pretty happy with it.
fits perfectly.
I am glad I found a replacement filter that costs so much less than the OEM filter.  I haven't been able to use it yet because our refrigerator needs to be repaired.
Caused too much pressure in our GE Profile fridge. Water shot out, inlet diameter of filter is significantly smaller than GE OEM. Bit the bullet and went back with GM filter.
So glad to have found this product. It does the job and is a lot less than the name brand.
Works just as great as the name brand products for a much more reasonable price. No leaks, easy to install, & water tastes good.
Very satisfied with this filter so glad I found it on Amazon. Didn't want to pay $50 for the one that is recommended by the manufacturer of my fridge. Yes I do recommend.
Not so sure about this.  Took a while to get charcoal residue out before using.  Sometimes water still tastes a little "off".
Good as any I'd say.  Seems like typical razor-and-blades value proposition
This seems to be working just fine as a replacement for the more expensive OEM filter. I'm happy to pay a lot less for one, if it works as well.
I installed it and it is leaking where I fill water glasses.  I will reach out to the public Amazon forum for suggestions, may have to return for credit.
Fast shipping, easy install. Water tastes great at a fraction of the cost of my original GE filter.
Great, inexpensive replacement. Fit my fridge perfectly and the water tasted great.
Worked like a champ once all the air bubbles got worked out. Can tell no difference from OEM.
Wish it would filter out hormones
Tastes the same as the GE filters, and much less expensive!
Perfect generic replacement that was easy to install.  Installed it immediately and works like a charm!

I bought this cooler as an alternative to renting a cooler (which I did for years) from my water delivery service. I have been using it for almost a month and here's what I come away with.

Pros
1. It's a good looking piece of equipment and an attractive spot filler.
2. It offers a very nice HOT cup of water. I find myself using that function quite a bit. A very good thing about the 'hot' water button it has a
safety. It would be difficult for a child to accidentally be burned when dispensing or attempting to dispense water from either cold or hot side.
3. NO HEAVY LIFTING - it's bottom loaded, simple and very easy.
4. LED Indicator lights and alert sounds. When you're in need of replacement bottle it alerts you by sight and sound. Otherwise there is very little sound coming from the cooler, barely a hum. If it weren't for the lights I'd have to check to make sure it was still running. Lastly, the lights are a plus at night.

Cons
1. LED lights run all the time. There should be an option to turn them off.
2. As good as the hot water is at getting hot the cold water falls short. The water gets a chill not COLD. It gets just a little below room temp.
The cooler is placed at a diagonal position in a corner with 4" clearance on either side and 12" from the corner. That meets the requisite
requirements of placement to function optimally. I like really cold water and miss that from my previous

Works as described. Was disappointed that it sits so low and the opening between the base and the spout is really short so that larger bottles and pitchers don't fit. Overall it's a good product and I would recommend it.

Finding a reliable water dispenser turns out to be harder than it should be.  Keeping it clean so your family isn't getting sick from the bottled water is also a chore.  This is an excellent machine that works as advertised.  Cold water is cold; hot is hot.  The unit is sturdy and easy to use.  The self-cleaning feature is a god-send.  When the old Primo one that we had died (a little more ,than a year after we bought it), we did extensive research and settled on this Whirlpool.  It arrived many days earlier than the expected delivery date.  We are very satisfied.

So far, so good. I have only had it for a short while but it is, at least at this time a lot better than my old Primo top load model. It is very quiet. Even when the pump is sucking up the water from the bottle into the reservoir, it is quieter than the Primo one was when the compressor was running to cool the water. I can't barely hear the compressor on this on when it is running from across the room.

The best feature is that it is a bottom load so no more lifting bottles up top and less chance for an *accident*.

Well worth the extra money for this than buying a cheaper top load model. Plus it cleans it's self. The top load was annoying to clean every 6 months.
Nice!

More than expected.  Had knee surgery and couldn't lift the bottle onto a traditional cooler.  I fell in love with this thing - it is awesome!  The water is cooler, and the hot water is wonderful.  The dispensing of the water is also faster.  But loading is dream.

The cooler arrived with a serious dent in the door. The seller was very responsive and sent a replacement immediately, excellent customer service and prompt.
I have only had the cooler for a couple weeks. It delivers cold water as advertised, and is quiet.

Filling coffee pots and larger bottles is my only complaint, it is hard to get them under the spout, would be helpful to have a deeper area under the spout and longer distance to the bottom of the filling area.

This a beautiful looking machine.  It looks great in my kitchen and it's quieter than my last one. My only problem is that I wanted the cold water to be, well, colder.  I actually bought it because it advertise itself as having one of the coldest water dispensers.  My last machine had nice frosty water that colder then this one.  Not sure if there is anything I have to do to make the water colder.  This is the main reason for docking one star.  Otherwise, this dispenser is quite good.

This has completely exceeded my expectations! It is very attractive and I wouldn't change a thing about it.
I like that it only has hot and cold options. My previous 2 water coolers included a room-temperature option which I never used.
I love, love, love the self-cleaning feature!!! I was actually happy when my previous water cooler stopped working because going through all the steps to clean it with vinegar was torture. :(
The water bottle slides into this base more easily than my previous one and since this one attaches the hose to the bottle with a much more secure seal it manages to draw all but about a tablespoon of water out. Again, my much-inferior previous cooler would always leave a lot of water when it came time to change.
The company sent me another machine and it is working fine I have Hot water and cold water.  Everything is fine now

I saw that other reviewers claimed that the water isn't very cold.  I wonder if they know there's a switch in the back to turn on the compressor for refrigerated water, and a switch for the heated water as well.  The water on the cold side is actually colder than water that is stored in my refrigerator overnight.  I am very happy with this product and it has exceeded my expectations.

Nice look, pretty quiet except when the compressor is on.  Got 5gal bottles off AMZN too but it appears there are different necks that fit different coolers (who knew?) b/c the cap on this won't sit firmly on the ones I bought.  Does not affect the suction or performance but a warning that it will only fit XYZ type of 3g/5g bottle necks would have been good to know.  The hot water is very hot; would like to lower the setting but the work around is to start with hot and then add cold to achieve an immediately drinkable temperature.
Great machine
Works great.  Easy to load bottles.  Nice to have both hot and cold water.

This exceeded my expectations in appearance, quality, ease of use and water temperature! It is a lovely unit, sleek chrome with black accents. The door feels satisfyingly solid when closed. Swapping out bottles is a snap and I can make tea with the hot water while the cold water is always brisk and refreshing. Of course it makes some noise but it is muffled by the insulated cabinet. Noise cannot be avoided, but it is neither loud nor constant. My family uses it frequently, as our tap water is unpleasant. We keep a spare water bottle and refill as needed. We always know when we're running low thanks to the indicator beep. I must say, this doesn't waste a drop! I look forward to years of conveniently cold or hot water on demand with this attractive addition to my home.

I'm very pleased with this purchase. Fast delivery, placed the order one evening, it was shipped the next day and received in NJ two days later. Well packaged, not a dent or scratch. Only con was that the mat was missing, however, it's on the tiled kitchen floor without any vibration noise.It also runs much quieter than our refrigerator. The cold water runs about 50 degrees, which is cold enough for us. Were keeping the hot water turned off. The appearance is very good, especially without the bottle on the top and of course it's very easy to load.I would recommend buying this cooler.
One of our best purchases ever!  No more lifting heavy bottles.  The hot and cold water are VERY hot and VERY cold -- love it!

Best water cooler I have ever used. I have had a few delivery rentals over the years, utilitzed a number of styles regularly in the offices have worked, and have seen numerous versions as a home/lobby visitor. Not one I can think of ever touches this one in both function and fashion.

The price may be a little more than the average, but you get what you pay for. Considering a number of other stainless steel coolers are between $200-300, and they do not stack up in quality, this is the product to buy. I used it 10-12x/day for the last 5 months and it is as good as new.

The hot water is really hot and the cold water is really cold. The pump works great, and the water jug fits underneath easily. The display and controls look and feel right. As the pictures show it is one of the best looking coolers around. The fit and finish feels high quality and I am confident in the durability of this product.

I would definitely buy this again. I do not make recommendations lightly, but it currently has my full endorsement.
Excellent, I'm very happy  I bought this.
Really enjoy this water cooler.  It has been trouble free since purchase.
Love!
Exactly what I was looking for... Easy loading and sleek look. Plus it's self cleaning... Because who has time for that?

Happy ending... So good news, the original order was delivered early, BUT the bad news was its operation on startup was entirely too noisey inside our house (The noise was a rattling reciprocating noise in the compressor. like a shop piston air compressor)! Amazon and the manufacturer responded promptly with a replacement that was perfectly silent, with very cold and very hot water as it should be. Now fyi, it was not the same model number that we ordered. Same brand and original features but with additional features including adjustable thermostats for the cold and hot water. At the end of the day, we are continuing to be very happy Amazon customers drinking in silence from the unit.

I love this water cooler. I do hope to get many years of service from it. I've had it a month so far. (My first water cooler lasted 35 years and still worked, though the faucet leaked ridiculously and that's what ultimately lead me to buy a new one.) Before I bought it, I tried to find out more about the self cleaning aspect of this model, and was concerned that I'd have to buy some additional product on a periodic basis that would do the cleaning. I don't really understand how it works, but am happy to report that you don't need to buy anything like "cleaning cartridges." It does its cleaning thing without any additional consumable items.
That being said, if you do use the hot water feature, over time, you will need to demineralize the unit (and there are detailed instructions about how to do that.) I will probably only use the hot water feature on rare occasions, so I won't have to worry about that.
As I age, those 5 gallon bottles got harder to heft into position on a gravity feed cooler, so I am happier to be able to load them from the bottom by sliding them up the little wedge and into the unit.
I do especially like the little night light feature, as I do wander into the kitchen for water in the middle of the night and the light is bright enough to navigate to the cooler to fill my glass.
